structured.answer: According to the red strip at the top, the site doesn't calculate anything on this list yet: bonds (אגרות בונדס, אג"ח קונצרניות), ביטוח מנהלים, profit-sharing life insurance, savings policies, foreign-currency accounts and deposits, dollar-linked deposits, structured deposits (פיקדון מובנה) and gold. But the list, headed "מוצרים", also contains things that aren't products: a rating company (חברת דירוג), a fee (עמלת חליפין), הסדר חוב, היוון קצבה and the price of gold. So I don't fully trust it, and I'll ask my son or the bank before I decide anything.

findings.what: The heading promises 'מוצרים' (products), yet the list includes items that are not products: 'חברת דירוג' (a rating company), 'עמלת חליפין' (a fee), 'הסדר חוב' (a debt arrangement), 'היוון קצבה' (an action on a pension), 'LBMA Gold Price' (a price) and a company the issuer must appoint. It makes me doubt the whole list.
Every card has a red 'לא מחושב' tag and there's a red strip at the top; all that red is alarming and makes everything look dangerous
Dark background with white and green small text is hard to read with reading glasses; the source lines are tiny and cut off with '...'
The page opens with an English-letter product (ETC) and 'LBMA Gold Price', which made me feel it isn't for me
Unexplained codes like MF-28, TX2-01, TXA-28 and crossed-out dates
The same long sentence 'כשייסגר: יופיע במדריך...' repeats on every card and makes the page long and tiring
